title: A date with a time concatenated to text reads 1/31/2024 1:05:00 PM

source.quote: CONCATENATE converts numbers, dates, and Boolean values to text with the default format
source.supports: a date joined to text takes the default format; the page says & gives the same result as CONCATENATE

source.quote: FORMAT accepts a set of predefined format strings for Date/Time
source.supports: the example shows General Date of 2021-01-02 15:30 as 1/2/2021 3:30:00 PM and Long Time as 3:30:00 PM

derivation: Concatenation converts a date to text with the default format, taken to be General Date. DAX Guide shows General Date of 2021-01-02 15:30 in en-US as 1/2/2021 3:30:00 PM: month/day/year, then a 12-hour time with seconds and AM/PM. For 2024-01-31 13:05:00 that is 1/31/2024 1:05:00 PM.
alternative: No source names the default format of the implicit conversion. A 24-hour or ISO rendering would give 1/31/2024 13:05:00 or 2024-01-31 13:05:00.
